tournament.name: OCC May
tournament.description:
Congratulations on qualifying for the Officers Club Championship! You are one of the top 36 KARDS players in the world and that signals not only significant skill but also dedication to the game, and for that, we at 1939 Games are thankful!


All further communication and questions around this event should take place in the OCC Discord channel here: https://discord.gg/288DQexmng 

The tournament is a 36 player, single elimination tournament. All matches apart from the finals are best of 3 series while the finals are a best of 5 series.


The top 4 players on the in game ladder are automatically qualified for the Round of 8 Finals. The remaining 32 players will face off for the remaining 4 spots. The first phase of the tournament is a 32 player single elimination played over the course of 5 days.


Each player will bring 3 decks to the tournament with different main nations, the deadline for decklist submissions is no later than 1200 GMT on May 10th. To submit your deck lists, export your deck from the game client and paste them into a Discord DM to a tournament Admin. Specific admins will be labeled on the OCC Discord.

WARNING: If your deck lists are not received before the deadline, you will be disqualified from the tournament.


Players ranked 5-36 will have to organize their match time and date between themselves and play all their matchups between May 10th to 14th.


When a player wins with a deck in a series, they can not bring that deck again within the same series.


The final 4 players from the single elimination bracket will be qualified for the Round of 8. Seeding will be determined by how you finished in the Top 32 event.
